prompt:
A desktop settings page of a software-factory console, 1440 px wide, shown without browser chrome. Top bar: the project name "demo", a moon-and-sun theme toggle, the user "sebastian", "Log out". Nav row under it: "Board", "Notifications" (the current page), "factory", "costs", "alerts". Page heading: "Notifications".

Section "Connections":
- Telegram, connected: name "Telegram", detail "@sebastian", a quiet "Disconnect" button.
- Discord, not connected: name "Discord", a "Connect" action.

Section "Level per project", caption "The level you set for each project you read, with the default of needs-you where the project pings you, else off."
Four rows, each: project name, its current state, a way to set one of "off", "needs-you", "all":
- demo-app, now "default: needs-you"
- ai-software-factory, now "default: off"
- trading-socially, now "all" (the member's own setting)
- womb-site, now "off" (the member's own setting)
DESIGN DIRECTION "split pane": a settings split. Left, a narrow sticky column (about a quarter wide) headed "Connections" holding the two messenger rows stacked with room to breathe. Right, the wider column headed "Level per project" with the four rows as a clean table. A single vertical hairline divides the panes. The two panes have different visual weight: the left quieter, the right the work area. THEME: dark. Near-black page background, light text, one cyan accent for current things, amber for needs-you states, hairline borders, quiet.
label: split-dark
